searchText: A complete sweep of an account should be doable even today. If you set `tx.max_priority_fee_per_gas = tx.max_fee_per_gas`, the `effective_gas_price` will be exactly `tx.max_fee_per_gas` irrespective of the `base_fee_per_gas`. And since the exact gas required can be deterministic, we just need to set `tx.value` to `balance - tx.gas_limit * tx.max_fee_per_gas` Essentially, instead of settling the dust back to the sender, you give it out as a tip to the coinbase. Yes, it is possible, but it requires donating a bunch of money to proposer or running a specialized bot (with access to private key), and it breaks EIP-1559 pricing system (the user has to try to guess the gas price their transaction will land in, they cannot just sit it high and trust it'll land ASAP). 8130 x 1271 vulnerability

excerpts.content:
A complete sweep of an account should be doable even today. If you set `tx.max_priority_fee_per_gas = tx.max_fee_per_gas`, the `effective_gas_price` will be exactly `tx.max_fee_per_gas` irrespective of the `base_fee_per_gas`. And since the exact gas required can be deterministic, we just need to set `tx.value` to  `balance - tx.gas_limit * tx.max_fee_per_gas`

Essentially, instead of settling the dust back to the sender, you give it out as a tip to the coinbase.
